title: Plus Membership and Northgate Visa Uplift on Road Hazard Credits — Northgate Tire Center
content:
# Plus membership uplift on road hazard credits

**Benefit.** The Northgate Tire Center road hazard credit carries a member share read from two records of the tires' purchase: the Northgate Memberships record of the membership whose card was presented on that purchase, and the purchase's primary tender as recorded in Northgate Purchases & Returns.

| Membership presented on the tires' purchase | Primary tender of that purchase | Member share |
|---|---|---|
| Plus tier | Northgate Visa | 1.1 |
| Plus tier | any other tender | 1.05 |
| not a Plus tier | any | 1 — the full share |

A membership is a Plus tier when it carries a Plus premium above zero.

**How the share acts.** The road hazard credit is multiplied by the member share. The share acts on the unrounded credit, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Membership | Tender | A $90.00 credit before this share becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Plus tier | Northgate Visa | $99.00 |
| Plus tier | Northgate store card | $94.50 |
| not a Plus tier | Northgate Visa | $90.00 |
